AWS outage in US-EAST-1 knocks Slack, Venmo and Ring offline

Published 2026-10-07 09:40 UTC

A widespread Amazon Web Services outage on Wednesday morning took down or degraded dozens of popular apps, including Slack, Venmo, Ring, Fortnite and Duolingo. The AWS Health Dashboard reported increased error rates and latencies for multiple services in the US-EAST-1 region in northern Virginia, the company's oldest and largest.

Engineers identified elevated error rates for DynamoDB as the starting point, which cascaded to EC2, Lambda and other services that depend on it. Downdetector logged more than four million problem reports worldwide during the outage.

AWS said at 9:30 a.m. Eastern that it was seeing early signs of recovery but that some services would take longer to fully recover as backlogs cleared. The outage is the largest since a similar US-EAST-1 incident in 2021 and renews questions about how much of the internet depends on a single cloud region.
